items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: He played with us. He played with your son of Montgomery. He played with us at the same time.

ctx.x: By the way, one time there was a little brother Montgomery, he came from Mississippi. Did he ever bring him? We picked him up in Jackson, Mississippi. Well he played with us. He played with your son of Montgomery. He played with us at the same time. He made it too with us.

We picked, his name is Uro Montgomery. We called him little brother Montgomery. But we picked him up in Jackson, Mississippi. The same place we picked up Eugene Porter. You see, because some of the boys didn't want to make that long trip. We picked Eugene Porter up in Jackson, Mississippi and we picked brother Montgomery, little Uro Montgomery. Pick him up. And he could play some piano. He still does. He still works. He was down here last year. Yeah, well I'd like to see him. You know he got off the beam one…
But he left us in Omaha. He had to go make some records.
